name: Rosuvastatin
description: A high-intensity hydrophilic statin approved for hyperlipidaemia and cardiovascular risk reduction. Largely renally excreted rather than CYP3A4-metabolised, with dose limits in renal impairment and in some ancestry groups.

systems.note: Inhibition of hepatic HMG-CoA reductase lowering LDL cholesterol and cardiovascular event rate; placed on the heart by intended effect rather than on the liver where the enzyme sits.
Transaminase elevation is a labelled class effect and the liver is the site of the enzyme, not the target.
Myopathy and, rarely, rhabdomyolysis are labelled class effects.
A small increase in incident diabetes is a labelled class effect.

monitors.why: The direct index of the effect the drug is given for.
Counts atherogenic particles, which LDL-C mass does not.
Sums every atherogenic particle and is computable from a standard panel.
Myopathy is the labelled class effect; CK is the operative marker when muscle symptoms appear.
Labelled small increase in incident diabetes.
